{{dablink|For other uses of the words "gold" and "heaven," see [[Gold]] and [[Heaven]].}}
'''The Golden Swans of Heaven''' is an inn located in [[Ebou Dar]], capital of [[Altara]]. Despite the grandiose name, the inn is very small and is squashed between a stable and a shop. The innkeeper's name is [[Darnella Shoran]].
